# Quote session 20260925-053931 (boot 68): the raw exchange, for re-verification

One run of the node's `tpmattest.exe` (sha256 `ebc30d9f…6982`, source `windows/node/tpmattest.c` at `a80c919e`)
driven by `verify/tpmquote/quote-verify.mjs`. Summary and verdict: `../boot68-2026-09-25.md`.

| file | what |
|---|---|
| `keys.txt` | the helper's `keys` reply: EK certificate (DER hex), transient AK `TPMT_PUBLIC`, AK name |
| `activate.txt` | the `activate` reply, including the credential the TPM recovered |
| `quote.txt` | `TPMS_ATTEST`, signature and signing scheme, AK public |
| `pcr0.txt` | PCR 0 as read live in the same session |
| `measuredboot-0000000068.log` | the boot's SRTM log, sha256 `8ee177c4e05165c6e4dc4294f32fe38c1e279656c48b2df9db17cadf6ceecb0b` |
| `verifier-inputs-after-session.json` | the verifier's 32-byte nonce and minted credential. Published AFTER the session: the AK they were bound to was a transient key flushed when the helper exited, so they authorize nothing now |
| `meta.txt` | the box-side runner's timeline |
| `verdict.json` | every relay check and its result |

Re-verify offline:

    node windows/vbslike/verify/tpmquote/quote-verify.mjs verify <a copy of this folder with the log renamed measuredboot.log
                                                                  and the inputs file renamed verifier-secret.json>

The negative controls are generated by `quote-verify.mjs` from these bytes, as in-memory mutations. They are not
stored separately.
